Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
DOC-0031 2026-10-21
MEMORANDUM
Date: 2026-10-21
To: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA queue coordinators
From: PERSON-O0011, TEAM-0005
Subject: Glossary Practice for ALPHA Queue Coordinators
Decision: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA will hold a glossary practice session on
2026-10-22 at 12:40 for intake clerks and queue coordinators. The session
concentrates on record vocabulary that can be confused during a spoken
handover.
The trainer will distinguish issue status from task status, task kind from
subsystem, and exact open from the collective term unresolved. Use the
existing desk glossaries as the vocabulary source. Do not invent shorter
category names merely because they are easier to say during a call.
A dictation exercise will have the receiving clerk write labels with their
underscores intact and name the record type beside an ambiguous term. A
separate blank-field exercise will distinguish an absent person assignment
from an absent owning-team entry. The recorder's name must not be used to
fill either example by inference.
Use ISSUE-0028 and TASK-0060 as locating references for the electrical
training folder. TASK-0061 and TASK-0062 may identify separate review
discussions on the exercise sheet. The session does not supply values for those
records.
Implementation: PERSON-0011 will prepare the blank exercise sheet before
the session. The trainer will collect unclear definitions as questions for the
records coordinator, retain the original spelling, and attach the answer to the
teaching copy. The station clerk will keep that copy beside the intake reference
binder.
D. Worker 00117
Demo Worker 0011, Demo Team 05
